contract: Optional 1-4 copied evaluators with explicit primaryEvaluatorId and evaluatorPolicy: all; source aliases bind exact current revisions; legacy singular import remains supported.

validation.example: Two answers passed two copied judges: six injected synthetic invocations with no external model calls.
validation.static: Focused new/affected Python lint, new-file format, JavaScript syntax and diff whitespace pass; the existing studio_operations.py:83 B904 is unchanged.
validation.browser: Pending; no attempt to bypass the prior localhost permission denial.
validation.live_provider: Not used. Real provider grading quality, billing and concurrency remain account-dependent.

guarantees: One target invocation per case/repetition/variant; selected judges reuse the same answer
Every selected evaluator and existing deterministic check must pass the case
Primary identity labels reports without overriding other judge failures
Reference data reaches graders only and template requirements validate before queueing
Copied settings remain independent of later source edits and forged incoming settings
Import requires complete exact revision bindings and rejects duplicate native evaluators
Native review, save and export preserve copies without starting runs
Grading progress persists target answer and completed grades across file/SQL cancellation/restart
Interrupted grading follows the existing whole-slot dispatch receipt and cannot automatically replay
Invalid/failed grading retains prior evidence and cannot pass through a zero threshold
Target failure invokes no graders and produces blocked partial evidence rather than a missing-grader validation error
Offline gating checks manifest, primary identity, grader completeness and flat/nested score consistency
Existing inline-judge experiments, reports and workflow approval continuation remain compatible
limits: Only explicit all-evaluator acceptance is supported
Evaluator copies are reviewed configuration, not cryptographic proof of provenance
Workflow experiments still require one worker
Visual browser, physical-device and live-provider acceptance remain pending
migration: Additive optional experiment/report fields; no persisted-state migration. Older runtimes need an update before reading evaluator-set configurations.
next: Reviewed external-format experiment export with diagnostics for nonrepresentable native settings.
